item.essentialis.chakram.desc: Throw it to strike enemies from afar. It bounces off blocks and returns to the player.
item.essentialis.hammer.desc: Mines a 3x3 area like an iron pickaxe and shovel combined. Repaired with iron blocks.
item.essentialis.wayback_stone.desc: Saves the player from death, leaving one heart, and returns them to their spawn point. Grants 30 seconds of fire resistance. 15 minute cooldown.
enchantment.essentialis.bouncing.desc: Allows the chakram to ricochet to a nearby enemy after a hit. Each level adds one ricochet.
enchantment.essentialis.harvesting.desc: Harvests crops and foliage the chakram flies through.
enchantment.essentialis.lightweight.desc: Increases the chakram's flight range by 7.5 blocks per level.
enchantment.essentialis.phasing.desc: Allows the chakram to pass through enemies. Each level pierces one additional enemy.
enchantment.essentialis.ricochet.desc: Increases damage for each block the chakram has bounced off, plus 0.5 damage per level.
enchantment.essentialis.scavenger.desc: Picks up items the chakram flies past and brings them back.
tooltip.essentialis.wayback_stone.line1: Cheats death and returns the player to their respawn point.
item.essentialis.citrine_ring.desc: Signals about danger. All hostile mobs in range of 16 blocks will be highlighted. This effect cannot be stacked.
item.essentialis.jade_ring.desc: Grants 10% bonus movement speed and jump boost.
item.essentialis.ruby_ring.desc: Heals back 10% of dealt damage to others. This effect cannot be stacked.
item.essentialis.sapphire_ring.desc: Grants 25% bonus movement speed in water or lava and also reduces burn time by 25%.
item.essentialis.tanzanite_ring.desc: Doubles duration of any status effect. This effect cannot be stacked.
item.essentialis.topaz_ring.desc: Grants luck. Netherite upgrade doubles it and brings fortuitous finds.
Signals about danger. All hostile mobs in range of 32 blocks will be highlighted. It will additionally set all undead mobs on fire within 16 blocks. This effect cannot be stacked.
item.essentialis.netherite_jade_ring.des: Grants 20% bonus movement speed and jump boost. This effect additionally works while riding (on tamed mobs or vehicles).
item.essentialis.netherite_ruby_ring.des: Heals back 25% of dealt damage to others. This effect cannot be stacked.
item.essentialis.netherite_sapphire_ring: Grants 50% bonus movement speed in water or lava, 50% more breath and reduces burn time by 50%.
item.essentialis.netherite_tanzanite_rin: Doubles duration of any positive status effect. This effect cannot be stacked.
item.essentialis.netherite_topaz_ring.de: Grants +2 luck and provides bonus chance for rare finds when fishing, mining, hunting and looting.
